Q 版角色美术 / Chibi character artwork
Author: fywdy
Source: https://github.com/fywdy/chatgpt-chibi-pets
License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

Characters used: ChatGPT white dragon, Claude orange scholar, DeepSeek whale maid,
Gemini star cat, Grok gothic. Community fan art; not official provider characters.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the model providers.

Modifications: extracted the first idle-animation frame, cropped transparent
margins and made portrait crops. Full-body idle frames are selectable decorations.
No model provider, model capability or business role is implied by a character.

The image assets are limited to noncommercial use. The upstream MIT code license
does not license the artwork for commercial use. See the accompanying complete
CC BY-NC 4.0 license and upstream NOTICE.
